jobs.name: cat_portrait_happy.png
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single character HUD portrait. Generate exactly ONE chest-up portrait of the cat-girl, facing the viewer directly, on genuinely transparent background. Canvas 1024x1536 portrait. Match the four portraits' size and framing: head and cat ears fully visible, centered face, framing from above ears down to chest, same face scale and chest crop in each expression. Reference images 1 and 2 ONLY define finished drawing style: crisp expressive anime linework, detailed shaded rendering. Reference 3 ONLY defines the character design, not pose, perspective or expression. Preserve her white bob haircut with small braids, white cat ears with pink interiors, red eyes and thin red glasses, red ribbon and gold bell ornament, cream kimono-style sailor top, navy sailor collar, red ties, and mint sleeve lining. Do not change design. If arms appear, her RIGHT ARM alone is the white furry clawed paw with red markings, left arm is human. No gun, no visual effects or aura. No full-body figure, no second pose, no grids, no text, no background, no border, no watermark.
Expression: HAPPY. A clearly cheerful warm smile, relaxed brows and bright happy eyes looking directly at the viewer. Keep the same chest-up portrait framing.
jobs.qa: 1024x1536 PNG alpha, facing viewer, intended expression present. Generated framing extends to waist rather than chest; face scale and pose vary between four independent portraits.
